Tom — thanks again for the demo time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so your security team has what they need to complete the vendor review: 

1) Documents requested
   - SOC 2 Type II report (latest 12 months) OR temporary attestation + expected Type II delivery window
   - Bridge letter if applicable (if the full Type II period doesn't cover the timeframe)
   - Completed vendor security questionnaire (we can host a DSQ or accept your spreadsheet)

2) Access options
   - We can provision read-only access to our Trust Portal (recommended) for artifact download
   - If you prefer, we can provide an SFTP/Secure Drop link for direct uploads from your side

Action items: can you confirm the primary security contact(s) and preferred transfer method? If portal access is easiest, please share the email(s) to invite and we’ll send a 72-hour temporary link.

Attachment: redwood_bridge_letter_template.pdf (PDF, 48 KB)

Thanks — Ben
